benefit: English lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) thrives on dry orchard headlands, drawing honeybees and bumble bees during long mid-summer bloom. Strong dual-use as cut-stem and dried-flower crop.

members.title: Lavender row at orchard headland
members.body: Plant lavender plugs 24 inches apart on a free-draining orchard headland. Mulch heavily for the first year, then drought-grown.
